candidate.title: Hi-SCL
candidate.scope: The assigned Hi-SCL RNA-seq row: soluble barcode-library droplets and cell/lysis droplets converge through fusion with RT buffer, followed by collection of intact droplets, a broad cDNA synthesis/amplification block, and sequencing. The separately labeled MULTI-Seq fragment above and inDrop row below are adjacent poster context, not alternative targets of this Hi-SCL card. The single-cell-to-poly(A)-RNA vignette identifies the analyte and is not a separate extraction operation. The primary-paper implementation clarifies the compartment boundary and the DNA carrier without expanding the broad block into an execution recipe.

states.label: Soluble barcoded DNA oligonucleotides
features: The diagram labels oligo(dT) and a universal primer region.
Primary implementation: 5′ common priming region, 10-nt cell-label barcode, and 3′ oligo(dT)18-V segment, where V is A, C or G.

End orientation follows the explicit Methods sequence and Barcode design text [b00019-b00020]; the same paper’s Figure 2D caption reverses the poly(T) end in its prose. The Illumina legend itself supplies no 5′/3′ end annotation.

states.label: Sequence reads associating a cell-label barcode with an mRNA-derived sequence
features: The diagram calls this endpoint Barcoded mRNA from single cells; physically the sequenced library is amplified DNA representing mRNA.
Paired-end reading links a barcode at one end to a transcript-derived sequence at the other.
These associations support cell-associated gene-expression profiles; barcode collisions, multicell droplets and cross-talk limit a literal one-barcode/one-cell interpretation.
Gene attribution comes from the transcript-derived portion; the barcode supplies the intended cell association rather than identifying the gene itself.

operations.label: cDNA synthesis and amplification
operations.description: Convert the collected compartmentalized mRNA into cell-barcoded cDNA, then amplify the barcoded DNA. The paper resolves the internal boundary of this broad block: RT occurs inside droplets; the emulsion is then broken for bulk processing and amplification.
operations.mechanism: The oligo(dT) segment hybridizes to mRNA poly(A) and primes reverse transcription; its barcode becomes part of the cDNA. Amplification retains that encoded cell association.
operations.information_effect: Transfers the association from physical confinement to the DNA barcode carried by each mRNA-derived cDNA.
